\section*{Precision of the singleton set}
\begin{figure}[H]
\centering
\includegraphics[width=0.5\linewidth]{fig_pr}
\caption{Precision--recall curve of the primary model on the test period (seed 42) with the positive predictive value and sensitivity of the singleton set $\{1\}$ of the static and online class-conditional sets at $\alpha = 0.10$. The singleton of a static set is issued exactly for the stays whose score exceeds one threshold, so its operating point lies on the curve; the three Mondrian points nearly coincide. Dotted line: event rate. MIMIC-IV-ED, retrospective single-center proxy.}
\label{fig:pr}
\end{figure}
